title: Error: "VCRUNTIME140.dll was not found" or "MSVCP140.dll is missing"
summary: An app or game needs Microsoft's Visual C++ runtime files, and they're missing or damaged. Installing Microsoft's runtime fixes it.
cause: Many apps and games rely on shared Microsoft runtime files (the Visual C++ Redistributable). If they were never installed, or an update or cleanup tool removed them, the app can't start.
steps: Open the Microsoft page 'Latest supported Visual C++ Redistributable downloads' (link below).
Download and install both the X64 and the X86 versions. Many games need the 32-bit (X86) one even on 64-bit Windows.
If the installer offers Repair, choose Repair.
Restart your PC and open the app or game again.
Do not download the single DLL file from a 'DLL download' website. Those files are often outdated or unsafe.
ifStillBroken: Uninstall and reinstall the app or game. If it still fails, Open Terminal (Admin): right-click Start and choose Terminal (Admin). Type DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHealth and press Enter. When it finishes, type sfc /scannow and press Enter. Restart when both are done.
